digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / completion verifier / attestation guard
propositions: [operator-attested] tagged acceptance criteria with code-verifiable repository evidence (exact paths/symbols) bypass review-side guards and are accepted by the completion verifier at close
The evidence-kind criterion fails to deterministically reject tagged ACs citing repo paths, relying instead on nondeterministic LLM judgment with no fail-closed backstop
det_measurement_provenance detects missing provenance lines but surfaces findings as ADVISORY, insufficient to block close on the review path

A deterministic pre-close guard must reject mistagged code-verifiable ACs (with repo path/symbol evidence cited) before the completion verifier runs, since the verifier trusts tags by contract (ADR-0043)

Mixed-evidence ACs (repo-verifiable + external outcome) require split into separate tagged/untagged criteria; evidence-vs-orientation heuristic distinguishes test citations (inherently completion proof) from repo references (orientation-only without explicit evidence markers)
